entities.summary: Bryant McIntosh is an American basketball coach and former player who is currently an assistant coach for the Northwestern Wildcats of the Big Ten Conference. He also played college basketball for Northwestern, and holds the school's single-game, single-season, and career assist records. He was a 2017 All-Big Ten team second-team selection and led the 2016–17 Northwestern Wildcats to the first NCAA tournament in school history.
